summary_md: **Naman Jain ([@jus_eng_njainam](https://x.com/jus_eng_njainam/status/2115308694678491603))** warns that the new **Ling-3.1-flash-1019** model card's SGLang command still serves the old model (`--model-path inclusionAI/Ling-3.1-flash`), and because config and chat template are byte-identical nothing errors to warn you.
relevance: A silent model-card pitfall for anyone serving Ling locally.
